free_tier_limits: Speech-to-Text V1: 60 audio minutes per month per account at $0 for Standard models, with or without data logging. V2 has no recurring free allotment in the current pricing table; new customers may separately qualify for Google Cloud trial credits.
rate_limits: V1 defaults per developer project: 900 recognition requests per 60 seconds, 10 adaptation-resource requests per 60 seconds, and 480 audio-processing hours per day. Most quotas can be adjusted through Google Cloud.
resolution_notes: base_url: Corrected; the REST reference names https://speech.googleapis.com as the service endpoint: https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs/reference/rest. free_tier_limits: Corrected to the current V1 60-minute allotment; V2 charges from minute 0: https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/pricing. rate_limits: Corrected because V1 publishes explicit quotas: https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs/v1/quotas.
